## What's new in 0.1.2

- **One title bar of Fern's own on every platform**, as in Zed. The system title bar is gone and
  every column runs up to the window's top edge; its top strip moves the window and maximizes it
  on a double click. The window's buttons sit in that strip: the traffic lights on macOS, the
  caption buttons in the top-right corner on Windows, and the desktop's buttons on Linux, where
  Fern also draws the window's edge and shadow and resizes it from there.
